description: Current citations to the early papers (overlaps the target; models are run with and without).
Early papers in top-10% venues (by 2-yr mean citedness) or a hand-listed set of major AI venues.
1 if any early coauthor is in the top 5% of coauthors by current h-index (approximation: uses today's h-index).
Mean number of authors per early paper.
Quartile of the author's most frequent early institution by institution h-index: 1=top ... 4=bottom, 0=unknown.
Shannon entropy (nats) of primary topics across early papers.
Fraction of early papers where the author is listed first.
t0: year of first indexed publication (control).
